rubric.role_summary: Senior embedded software engineering role leading firmware architecture and technical projects for distributed home battery systems, including hardware integration and reliable operation at fleet scale.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior embedded software engineering role leading firmware architecture and technical projects for distributed home battery systems, including hardware integration and reliable operation at fleet scale.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 5+ years of experience developing embedded software or firmware.
- Deep expertise in C, C++, or Rust.
- Experience designing embedded systems that interact directly with hardware.
- Experience with microcontrollers, embedded Linux, or real-time systems.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience reading hardware schematics and datasheets to guide firmware design and integration.
- Experience with the embedded Linux ecosystem, including kernel configuration, driver development, and device update mechanisms.
- Familiarity with modern processor architectures (ARM, RISC-V) and trade-offs in selecting platforms for embedded systems.
- Experience developing and debugging software on custom hardware.
- Working knowledge of power electronics or energy systems.
- Familiarity with safety and regulatory certification processes (UL1998, UL1741, UL1547).
- Understanding of system architecture, reliability, and failure modes in production hardware systems.
- Experience building software for systems deployed at scale.
- Track record of leading complex technical projects and shaping system architecture.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: Greater Austin, TX area. Onsite work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
